verdict.rationale: Companies House is the UK's statutory public register of companies, and its scope is defined by UK jurisdiction ('We hold the UK's register of companies'). Letting a filer choose the storage region or residency of register data is a category error for a national government registry: picking a different region would mean picking a different registry. Nothing in the evidence shows any region-selection capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
